$comment: Re-request missing required/review checks on the same live head using its existing PR workflow run. Env > this file > defaults; sources logged by policy-cascade. WE_MISSING_RUN_REREQUEST=on|off, WE_MISSING_RUN_COOLDOWN_MINUTES (positive minutes; default 15), WE_MISSING_RUN_MAX_ATTEMPTS_PER_HEAD (default 2). Attempts are reserved in trusted PR thread comments before submission. No workflow_dispatch: a branch ref cannot pin the live head.
